ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, block A is relatively large and is placed on horizontal ground; block B is relatively small, located on the left side of A and attached to the vertical contact surface of A; on the left side of B there is an external-force arrow horizontally to the right, indicating that B is pressed toward A by a horizontal force. Reasoning: Let the masses of A and B be m_A and m_B respectively, and let the normal force between A and B be N. B is just not sliding downward, which indicates that B has a tendency to slide downward; the friction force exerted by A on B is upward and reaches the maximum static friction force, with magnitude μ_1N. For B, equilibrium in the vertical direction: m_Bg=μ_1N. Analyzing A: the horizontal pressure exerted by B on A is N, directed to the right; A is just not sliding, so the friction force exerted by the ground on A is to the left and reaches its maximum value. B is subjected to the upward friction force from A, therefore A is subjected to the downward friction force from B, whose magnitude is equal to m_Bg. Therefore the supporting force exerted by the ground on A is (m_A+m_B)g. The maximum static friction force between A and the ground is μ_2(m_A+m_B)g, and the critical equilibrium gives N=μ_2(m_A+m_B)g. Combining m_Bg=μ_1N and N=μ_2(m_A+m_B)g gives m_B=μ_1μ_2(m_A+m_B). Therefore m_B(1-μ_1μ_2)=μ_1μ_2m_A, namely m_A/m_B=(1-μ_1μ_2)/(μ_1μ_2).

raw_record.question_text: As shown in the figure, block A is placed on horizontal ground, and block B is pressed tightly against block A under the action of a horizontal force (the contact surface between A and B is vertical). At this moment A is just not sliding, and B is just not sliding downward. It is known that the kinetic friction coefficient between A and B is $\mu_{1}$, the kinetic friction coefficient between A and the ground is $\mu_{2}$, and the maximum static friction force is equal to the sliding friction force. Find the mass ratio of A to B.

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出结构：B在A左侧，与A的接触面竖直；B受向右的水平外力压向A；A放在水平地面上。设A、B质量分别为m_A、m_B，A、B间正压力为N。由文字读出临界状态：A恰好不滑动，B刚好不下滑，且最大静摩擦力可按μN计算。对B竖直方向列平衡：B有下滑趋势，A对B的摩擦力向上且达到最大值，所以m_B g=μ_1 N。对A分析：B对A的水平压力为N向右，地面对A的摩擦力向左且达到最大值；同时B对A的摩擦力向下，大小等于m_B g，因此地面对A的支持力为(m_A+m_B)g。A恰好不滑动给出N=μ_2(m_A+m_B)g。联立m_B g=μ_1 N和N=μ_2(m_A+m_B)g，解得m_A/m_B=(1-μ_1μ_2)/(μ_1μ_2)。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中滑块A较大，放在水平地面上；滑块B较小，位于A的左侧并与A的竖直接触面相贴；B左侧有一水平向右的外力箭头，表示B被水平力压向A。

推理：设A、B质量分别为m_A、m_B，A、B间正压力为N。B刚好不下滑，说明B有向下滑的趋势，A对B的摩擦力向上且达到最大静摩擦力，大小为μ_1N。对B竖直方向平衡：m_Bg=μ_1N。

对A分析：B对A的水平压力为N，方向向右；A恰好不滑动，所以地面对A的摩擦力向左且达到最大值。B受到A向上的摩擦力，因此A受到B向下的摩擦力，大小等于m_Bg。因此地面对A的支持力为(m_A+m_B)g。A与地面间最大静摩擦力为μ_2(m_A+m_B)g，临界平衡给出N=μ_2(m_A+m_B)g。

联立m_Bg=μ_1N与N=μ_2(m_A+m_B)g，得m_B=μ_1μ_2(m_A+m_B)。所以m_B(1-μ_1μ_2)=μ_1μ_2m_A，即m_A/m_B=(1-μ_1μ_2)/(μ_1μ_2)。

claims.source: Combining m_Bg=μ_1N and N=μ_2(m_A+m_B)g gives m_B=μ_1μ_2(m_A+m_B). Therefore m_B(1-μ_1μ_2)=μ_1μ_2m_A, namely m_A/m_B=(1-μ_1μ_2)/(μ_1μ_2).
